objective: Execute approved WorkUnit DAGs with bounded parallelism under grouped path-lease families and supervised native children, complete review with an explicit auditable unverified override, and recover the whole chain after daemon faults.
end_state: After exact plan approval, a task dispatches every dependency-ready WorkUnit concurrently up to a configured bound; each in-flight unit holds one durable LeaseFamily covering all its path leases; every native child runs under a ChildSupervisor that can cancel and prove the whole set dead; a task whose failed checks are explicitly overridden lands UnverifiedAccepted with a durable per-override audit row exposed on all four clients; a daemon restart reconciles every in-flight unit exactly once — resume or quarantine, never re-execute, never lose a completion.
non_goals: Git worktrees or any checkout-level isolation between parallel units (INV-10: same-checkout optimistic concurrency only)
Automatic staging, committing, pushing or ref writes
Re-planning the DAG while execution is in flight

environment.notes: Continue on the post-P32 tree (house 1128/1127/1; the single declared red is the plan_schema legacy schema_version 18-vs-35 baseline). Snapshots per task, no commits or pushes. The E06/E07/E09-R store migrations will MOVE that baseline number (18 is today's latest_schema; new migrations raise it) — redeclare the new pair in each task's verdict rather than hiding it. E05 changes only the canonical JSON blob inside the existing tasks table (no new table, no schema_version bump); its legacy-row fold is pinned by test because store load_task decodes with a silent .ok() that would otherwise drop old rows. File-gate headroom (quality_check file_loc, code lines): application.rs 2577/2600, run_manager.rs 2477/2600 — both tight, so new logic lands in new modules and every task that touches them carries a stay-under-gate criterion.

tasks.title: Generalize the kernel task state machine for concurrent units
tasks.description: Today task.rs enforces exactly one in-flight unit: start_execution_attempt requires Ready, verification moves the WHOLE task to Verifying carrying one work_unit_id, candidate/ValidationOutcome/ReviewDisposition are single-slot, and non-writable units cannot start at all. Generalize to N concurrent InProgress units with per-unit outcomes, and decide read-only unit semantics explicitly. The kernel shape change ships in the SAME task as the migration of the entire grep-enumerated consumer ring (git grep candidate_digest / TaskExecution::Verifying / .validation across the workspace) so the workspace stays green at the E05 boundary; runtime dispatch stays single-unit until E06. The harness-protocol wire keeps its task-level candidateDigest aggregates — derived at the RPC boundary from per-unit records, never stored in kernel state. Depends on O00 because the runtime call-site edits land in the carved modules (run_drive.rs/review_flow.rs), not the pre-split monoliths.

tasks.title: Group every attempt's leases into one durable LeaseFamily
tasks.description: One family per in-flight attempt: all of a unit's path leases acquired atomically (all-or-nothing), the family keyed by the attempt record from E06, and restart recovery that reconciles whole families rather than loose leases.

files.what: Add lease_families table keyed by attempt_id.

subtasks.description: Persist families keyed by attempt_id; the family's fencing is the workspace ownership epoch the member leases already carry (derive, never a new counter); acquiring a family acquires every member lease or none.
A family release releases exactly its member leases and settles the attempt record; a stale attempt cannot release or extend.
Restart reconciliation: a family whose attempt settled releases; one whose attempt is incomplete quarantines with its members fenced.

tests.description: A family whose second member lease conflicts acquires nothing and the first lease is not held (all-or-nothing).

Crash between family acquire and settle: restart either resumes-once or quarantines the whole family (pinned: parallel attempts from different tasks never fence each other's families).

acceptance_criteria: A family never partially exists.
Fencing reuses the existing workspace ownership epoch; no third epoch currency exists.
No lease outlives its family's durable settle or quarantine.

tasks.title: Supervise every in-flight native child under one ChildSupervisor
tasks.description: One registry owning the supervised trees of all in-flight attempts. Registration is explicit at the two seams where tree ids are BORN: plugins/session.rs (the only spawn_plugin call site — the PluginProcess/tree_handle is encapsulated there and must expose the supervised tree id for the owning run) and services/processes.rs (open_profiled returns an operation token; the tree id must be surfaced alongside it from the process_supervisor record). The dispatcher in parallel.rs consumes the surfaced ids; child_supervisor.rs is the registry itself — no journal interception, no second state machine.

tasks.title: Recover the full chain after a daemon fault
tasks.description: With N units in flight, a daemon restart reconciles the whole chain from the durable attempt records (work_unit_attempts) and their lease families: each in-flight attempt resolves exactly once — resume-once where its own evidence proves it safe, quarantine where it does not — families follow their attempts, supervised trees follow their proofs, and no completion is lost or duplicated.
